description:
Bookable times at one venue, on one date, for one party size.

        `date` is the venue's own local calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Each slot carries a
        `slot_id` to pass to book and a `starts_at` that is a full venue-local datetime, so
        a service running past midnight is unambiguous without you having to infer the day.

        An empty `slots` list means nothing is open on those terms, not that the venue is
        closed. Try a different time, party size or date before telling someone it is full.
name: get_availability
